newsitem.title: USA: 3Com Q1 system product sales rise.
newsitem.headline: 3Com Q1 system product sales rise.

text.p: 3Com Corp Tuesday said sales of systems products, which includes switches, hubs, and internetworking platforms rose 38 percent in the first quarter of fiscal 1997 to $416.4 million.
Sales of network adapters totaled $283.3 million, an increase of 52 percent from the year ago period.

3Com, a data networking company, said overall sales for the quarter ended August 31 totaled $707.0 million, an increase of 42 percent from the first quarter of fiscal 1996. Net income for the quarter was $93.1 million, an increase of 62 percent from the year ago period, while earnings per share for the quarter were $0.52, up from $0.33 a a year ago.
According to First Call, 3Com had been expected to earn $0.47 a share in the quarter.

"Our first quarter results underscore the positive impact of our strong new product cycle and the continued rise of our reputation and share across our strategic markets, including network adapters, workgroup switches and hubs," said Eric Benhamou, chairman and chief executive officer. "This foundation fuels our resolve to establish 3Com as a clear leader in the systems business while extending our leadership in the interface products business."
